launch_checklist.item: Client owns the Ads Manager account and invited ImpulsoX

day_1: Confirm serving, clicks, UTMs firing, reservation event received.
day_2_3: Pause rejected/broken ads. Ignore ads with < 100 clicks.
day_4_7: Compare ad groups by reservations, not CTR. Clone any ad with reservations.
day_8_14: Shift budget to lowest cost per reservation. Add 2-3 fresh variations.

client_brief.what_we_measure: We track online reservations as the primary conversion, plus clicks and landing-page views.
client_brief.expectations: ChatGPT Ads is a new channel without stable benchmarks. A local restaurant is a medium fit; the main goal of this first run is to learn the channel and produce real data.
client_brief.disclaimers: No results are guaranteed. This is an early, experimental ad channel; spend is the client's and performance can vary.
